verdict.rationale: Cal.com can be driven without its UI. API v2 supports API-key authentication through the Authorization header, and keys are managed in settings. The docs tell agents that can execute commands on a machine to use an official Cal.com CLI rather than calling the API directly. Bookings, availability, event types, schedules and webhooks are all exposed for scripted automation. Missing for 10: CI-specific documentation or examples, any depth on the CLI's commands and non-interactive behavior, and independent or hands-on confirmation of headless/CI use.
